solutions.title: Linear minimum scan
solutions.strategy: Inspect every value and keep the smallest one seen.

timeComplexity.explanation: All n values may need to be checked.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the current best value is stored.

solutions.title: Binary search pivot
solutions.strategy: Use the right boundary as an anchor; if mid is larger, the minimum is to the right, otherwise it is at mid or left.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each step halves the candidate range.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only two boundaries and a midpoint are maintained.
